name: recurpost
description: Schedule and publish social media posts through your RecurPost account.
long_description: Connects Claude to RecurPost (API v2) so you can post or schedule content, manage the queue, drafts, content libraries and their schedules, review posting history and reports, work with labels, approvals and the workflow board, and generate post copy or images with AI, in any workspace you belong to. Every other RecurPost API endpoint is reachable through the find_endpoints and call_endpoint tools. Requires a RecurPost account and an API key from Account Settings > API key.

email.title: RecurPost email
email.description: The email address you log in to RecurPost with.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Find it in RecurPost under Account Settings > API key. This is not your login password.

api_url.title: API URL (advanced)
api_url.description: Leave as it is unless RecurPost support gives you another address.
